description: This file implements command-line interface handlers for display management in the Cuttlefish project, including subcommands for adding, listing, removing, and taking screenshots of displays, as well as help handling.

classes.name: DisplaySubCommand
classes.description: Type alias for function pointers handling display subcommands

methods.name: GetInstanceNum
methods.description: Parses and retrieves the instance number from command-line arguments

methods.name: DoHelp
methods.description: Handles the 'help' subcommand, displaying usage information for other subcommands

methods.name: DoAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new display to a virtual device

methods.name: DoList
methods.description: Lists all connected displays for a given virtual device

methods.name: DoRemove
methods.description: Removes specified displays from a virtual device

methods.name: DoScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of a specified display and saves it to a file

methods.name: DisplayMain
methods.description: Main function for handling display-related command-line subcommands
